title: PipelineRunResult — Demo Driver Output Schema
description: Structural schema for the PipelineRunResult dataclass returned by pipeline.loop.run_pipeline.run_pipeline. Demo Driver MVP asserts every successful run conforms; M1 happy-path / M2 degraded / M3 law-enforcement / M4 perf classes all produce shapes that satisfy a subset of this schema. Three terminal shapes are encoded as the 'oneOf' branches.

run_id.description: Caller-minted idempotency key threaded through Round 3 fixed-factory closure.

final_phase.description: Terminal phase — one of three observable shapes per run_pipeline.py docstring.

iterations_consumed.description: Inner-loop iteration count. 0 only on PRE-gate soft-fail.

three_tab_envelope_hash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the three-tab envelope (Round 9 deliver_tab output). null only on bypass_pending or pre_gate_failed.

elapsed_ms.description: Wall-clock elapsed milliseconds (clock.now_ms() delta). Non-negative invariant.

bypass_pending.description: True iff POST-gate FAIL was caught and a bypass-pending sidecar marker was written.

pre_gate_failed.description: True iff PRE-gate returned passed=False (soft-fail, not exception).

pre_gate_failure_code.description: F-PRE-* failure code threaded from PreGateResult. null on success / bypass.

post_gate_rejected_trigger.description: PostGateRejected.trigger label threaded from POST-gate FAIL verdict. null on success / pre-gate fail.
